test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.

He had a natural mistrust of the inhabitants; and (also he was not disposed off to be quick friends) with anyone who had beaten his master.

options.text: also he was not at all disposed off to be quick friends
also he was not disposed to be quick friends
also he was not all disposed of to be quick friends

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence requires a correction in the phrase to make it grammatically correct and meaningful.
 
• The correct phrase should be "also he was not disposed to be quick friends" which correctly conveys the intended meaning.
 
• The word "disposed" should be used without "off" to fit the context properly.
 
• Thus, the error is located in the bracketed part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
